description: A DATA S_PDU that asks for client delivery confirmation, for a SAP no client is bound to, is discarded and answered with a DATA DELIVERY FAIL S_PDU, reason 1.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 7, not SAP 9. Link setup as dts-arq/rx-data-acked: at 2000 the peer 0.0.1.3 calls, our PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED goes at 52000, and when that transmission ends at 57550 the link is made as the Called node (B-0213), with cas.first_data and the SIS soft link timers. At 61000 the peer's DATA-ONLY (type 9, FSN 0, EOT 20) carries a DATA C_PDU whose DATA S_PDU is priority 0, source SAP 5, destination SAP 9, CLIENT DELIVERY CONFIRM REQUIRED and a VALID TTD 15 days ahead (byte 2 0xC0; interp A-0167), and 'ping'. It is stored and acknowledged as in that scenario (C-0658, C-0776, C-0778), stops cas.first_data (B-0215), and as ARQ traffic restarts sis.soft_link_idle (interp A-0320). No client is bound to SAP 9, so the U_PDU is discarded (A-0235), and since confirmation was asked a DATA DELIVERY FAIL goes back to 0.0.1.3 (A-0237, A-0239): TYPE 2, REASON 1, Destination SAP ID not bound, in the low nibble of byte 0 (A-0180, A-0181; interp A-0183), source SAP 5 and destination SAP 9 as received (A-0182), and the whole U_PDU, sis.frag_size being unset (A-0179; interp A-0341). It is sent as in sis-confirm/receiver-sends-confirm (interp A-0344, B-0318): handed down at once, so sis.soft_link_idle is cancelled and dts.ttd starts, and at 83000 it goes in a DATA-ACK with the acknowledgement, followed by an ACK-ONLY copy in the fill; the transmission ends at 93350 and dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts. Fixture, addresses and draws as dts-arq/rx-data-acked: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms; seed 0 draws 15, 4: contention waits 45000 and 12000 ms (K-0080). Since corpus 0.28.0 (P7-3), every D_PDU this node sends to a peer recorded Ed4 carries EOW 0xF01, CAPABILITY (Ed4 1, Duplex 0), where it carried EMPTY (C-0426, C-1260); an owed UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR still goes first (C-1079), and D_PDUs to a peer of unknown edition, a peer recorded Ed3 or a group carry EMPTY as before. Where this note says EOW 0 or EMPTY for such a D_PDU, read CAPABILITY. Only EOW and header CRC bytes changed.
